canonical_project: Wingu Africa Ethiopia Data Center ETH1
notes: Carrier-neutral hyperscale data center park at Ethio ICT Park, Addis Ababa on a 15,000 sqm plot; inaugurated June 2023 (USD 50m), first Ethiopian facility Tier III certified by Uptime Institute (2024); full build-out reported at 800 racks / 10 MW. Hosts ADDIX internet exchange. Operator also plans a second facility in Adama (Oromia).
